invariants.rationale: tileSet.putTile(tileId, tile) would throw a NullPointerException if tileSet were null.
A new StaticTiledMapTile is constructed with textureRegion, implying it must not be null.
tileSet.putTile(tileId, tile) stores a tile under tileId, so after, tileSet.getTile(tileId) should not be null.
The tile created is assigned tileId with setId(tileId), so after insertion, its id should match tileId.
The stored tile was created using textureRegion, so its getTextureRegion() should yield the same instance.
